title: Belief System
body_html:
Belief System

A belief system assigns to each information set $Q_i$ a probability distribution $\mu(Q_i)$ over the nodes of $Q_i$. Given beliefs and a behavioral profile, a player can evaluate expected continuation payoff for each action available at the information set.

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 6.4.2] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. A belief system assigns a probability distribution to each information set.
